exact_changes.old: Track numbers are not added together.
exact_changes.new: Energy/Turn and Card Plays each use their own **highest uncovered value**; neither track adds its uncovered numbers together.

exact_changes.old: Choose targets now, based on the current board.
exact_changes.new: Choose targets now, based on the current board. The Explore card is now in Build for next turn. In a matching land, a Slow Power that clears all Invaders can prevent that future Build if the land is still empty when Build resolves.

exact_changes.old: **Remove** returns the specified pieces without requiring Damage to reach their Health and without destruction Fear.
exact_changes.new: **Remove** returns the specified pieces without requiring Damage to reach their Health and without destruction Fear. Within the effect's count and piece-type restrictions, its decision-maker may choose any eligible pieces; there is no Explorer-first priority unless stated.

exact_changes.old: The current Terror Level determines what must be absent from the entire island:
exact_changes.new: At Terror Levels I–III, the conditions below require clearing particular Invaders from the entire island. **Earning the last Fear Card reveals Victory, winning regardless of remaining Invaders without resolving that card.** Apply the outcome timing below to every victory condition:
Dahan drowning gives no Energy. For these rules, **humans** means all Invaders (Explorers, Towns and Cities) and Dahan.

exact_changes.old: - **Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares:** Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence. An explicit instruction to Damage or Destroy Dahan does nothing to those Dahan; skip that instruction and resolve the rest of the Power normally. For each Power use, evaluate what it would destroy if resolved normally: generate **0 Fear per Explorer, 2 per Town, 5 per City**, and Push the would-be-destroyed Explorers/Towns. No real Damage is marked, so different Powers or a Repeat cannot combine their hypothetical Damage; multiple instructions **within one Power** can. Existing real Damage from others helps its hypothetical destruction and remains unchanged afterward. Within a single Power use, a given Invader can be pretend-destroyed only once. Repeats can “destroy” the same piece again for Fear. It does not get bonuses conditional on **actual** destruction (e.g., Mists of Oblivion or Vengeance of the Dead) from these pretend destructions. [Core: .7w4g7yx, .7w4g7yu, .7w4g8pj, .9v5kfh3, .9v5katc, .bu6oc6g]
